lines.text: Many learners say: I went to bed early yesterday night.
Better: I went to bed early last night.
Say last night, not yesterday night.
Last night! I went to bed early last night.

data.wrong: I went to bed early yesterday night.
data.right: I went to bed early last night.
data.why: Say last night, not yesterday night.
data.memory: I went to bed early last night.

native.tip: 「昨日の夜」は last night と言います。yesterday night は不自然です。
native.caption: “I went to bed early yesterday night.”と言っていませんか？😅 「昨日の夜」を直訳して yesterday night にしがちです。“I went to bed early last night.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。

en.tip: For last evening, say last night.
